a_revoir.message: You all know this grows by most roads and most off ramps. Take a drive out to the country and get a bursting pod, dry the seeds and plant them in fall, they will grow in the spring (I do it every year) they self pollinate. The price they are selling for is completely ridiculous for that few seeds. Feel like they think it is a pot seed!
a_revoir.motif: Diatribe sur le prix adressee a un autre abonne (« completely ridiculous », « feel like they think it is a pot seed »). Impossible a traiter sans discuter la grille de prix (garde-fou 3), et le ton ferme la porte a un echange utile.

a_revoir.message: Carrie Robertson that might be true for some areas, but milkweed is essential for the summer/fall migration as well! I'm in Missouri and the eggs laid on their way *back* to Mexico are the super generation- they've got the strength to make the migration! We take our monarchs seriously, raising every final instar caterpillar we can find through their pupa stage in a caterpillar enclosure.
a_revoir.motif: Long echange entre deux abonnees sur la super generation migratrice et l elevage de chenilles en enclos. Ces faits sortent de faits-verifies.json et le message ne s adresse pas a la Page.

a_revoir.message: People just remember when you’re amazing monarch ￼ have stripped your plants clean cut them down a little bit because they grow back don’t ever throw them away. They grow back.
a_revoir.motif: Conseil de rabattre les plants broutes plutot que de les jeter. Juste sur le fond (theme 19), mais quasi identique a une reponse deja publiee il y a une heure sur la MEME publication au sujet des plants depouilles. Ecarte pour ne pas repeter.

a_revoir.message: Imagine if schools across the migratory route, would plant milkweed!
a_revoir.motif: Souhait que les ecoles du corridor migratoire plantent de l asclepiade. Le fond a deja recu une reponse publiee il y a une heure (autoroutes, corridors, cours d ecole, avec Flockhart). Ecarte pour eviter un quasi-doublon thematique.

a_revoir.message:
I am looking for WWII milkweed pod pickers. I am on the board of The Michigan WWII Legacy Memorial, the state's official tribute to its contributions in WWII. We are commissioning a statue scene of kids picking milkweed pods. We are looking for folks who did this and want to hear their stories. If you did so, please contact me at russell.levine@michiganww2memorial.org or 248 875 8455.

Thanks
a_revoir.motif: Sollicitation du Michigan WWII Legacy Memorial cherchant des temoins ayant ramasse des gousses pendant la guerre, avec courriel et telephone. Demande legitime mais hors faits verifies, et repondre reviendrait a relayer les coordonnees d un tiers. A VOIR PAR UN HUMAIN: belle occasion de relations publiques, la soie servait a remplir les gilets de sauvetage.
Photo publiee sans aucun texte. Rien a quoi repondre.

Vraie question horticole, mais aucun fait verifie sur les pucerons ni sur la lutte; repondre exigerait d inventer. A VOIR PAR UN HUMAIN: sujet frequent qui meriterait une entree dans faits-verifies.json.
